summary: ML engineer building on-device LLM inference, PyTorch LLM training and post-training, and GPU and AI accelerator benchmarks.

highlights: Shipped **OpenWeights** to Google Play; its ExecuTorch LFM2.5 1.2B decodes **2.3× faster** than llama.cpp on Tensor G5.
Published **18 ExecuTorch LLMs (209 builds)** to Hugging Face for phone CPUs, GPUs, and Qualcomm and MediaTek NPUs.
Built **ExecuServe**, an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible phone server; Qwen3-1.7B first token took **0.41 s** on NPU, 2.0 s on CPU.
Merged a fix into **PyTorch ExecuTorch** that stops LFM2 models from carrying state into a new conversation.
Built KV cache prefix reuse on Android, cutting Qwen3-1.7B second-turn prefill from 5,852 to **215 ms** by reusing 1,192 tokens.
Measured 9 models across 9 CPU/GPU/NPU pairings on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5; NPU prefill ran **9.6–15.5×** the CPU on all 9.
Secured a **$2,000 compute grant** from Lambda for the team's GPU training and benchmarking work.
Designed an email-enrichment pipeline processing **2.6M records at 240K/day** and achieving **0.94 macro-F1** on validation.
Built ingestion for 2.7M registry records at 200K/day and an autoscaled multi-cloud pipeline validating 800K at 80K/day.
Delivered a patient-search AI system for a Philippine hospital in **30 days** using Google Cloud, Vertex AI, and AlloyDB.

highlights: Selected as a 2026 PyTorch Foundation Ambassador to run events, create content, and mentor PyTorch users in the Philippines.
Trained 4,000+ students and professionals in AI/ML, software engineering, and data engineering across 25+ talks.
Secured $30,000+ in sponsorships from GitHub, Tavily, and Vercel to support technology education across Luzon.
